title: Collision and non-collision for diffusions on configuration space
summary: We develop criteria for collision and non-collision of reversible infinitely many interacting diffusion processes in the real line. The approach is potential-theoretic and is based on capacity estimates for symmetric Dirichlet forms on the configuration space. Our main results are model-independent in the sense that no determinantal or Pfaffian structure, prescribed interaction potential, or explicit labelled stochastic differential equation is required.
